narr: Thunderstorms from a sea breeze moving northward from the Gulf Coast reached Central Alabama during the overnight and early morning hours of June 26. A microburst occurred in Talladega County, with tree damage reported. During the evening of June 27, thunderstorm activity moved northeastward across Jefferson County, causing wind damage and flooding in Homewood, Irondale, and Trussville, along with a report of hail in Irondale as well. Two injuries occurred in Jefferson County, one due to flooding and another with a tree falling on a house.
ev: Flooding was reported in parts of Homewood, Irondale, and Trussville. Highway 31 was flooded just south of Highway 280, along with 16th St and 1st Ave in Irondale. In Trussville, an individual was caught in floodwaters and swept through a culvert under Highway 11 near the entrance of the Stockton neighborhood, resulting in minor injuries.
lsr: Roadway flooded on Highway 31 just south of Highway 280 in Homewood.
